## dc9884cdb6ae

### A1 — Reproduced inert exact override

Audited generator SHA-256:
`4846ef2b28277510858066af9ad0758d4db43596e5b8094b6c33871a1f909663`.
Canonical rule hash: `8abe9031c394`.

The declared `n_twos` axis is not an exact control. I generated one complete
three-demo/one-query episode twice with seed `424242`, starting sample index `0`,
changing only `n_twos` from `1` to `5`. The four input grids and all four Racket
outputs are identical. Their observed color-2 counts are `[4, 2, 3, 3]` in both
runs, so neither request is enforced. The JSONL files differ only in provenance,
which records the requested override.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/dc9884cdb6ae/override_collision_summary.json`
- `checks/audit/dc9884cdb6ae/n_twos_1.jsonl`
- `checks/audit/dc9884cdb6ae/n_twos_5.jsonl`
- `checks/audit/dc9884cdb6ae/n_twos_1.log`
- `checks/audit/dc9884cdb6ae/n_twos_5.log`

The strict peer-audit preset also fails because the task has no portable tests
and declares no semantic teaching contract; see
`checks/audit/dc9884cdb6ae-combined/result.json`. Static inspection suggests
other declared controls are also unused, but A1 is the bounded reproduced
finding. No audit-only source was modified.
